label: Zoom Recording Downloader
title: Zoom Scraper: Recording Downloader & Transcripts
metaDescription: Turn shared Zoom recording links into downloadable video files, transcripts and meeting metadata. Works on meetings, webinars, events and clips.
intro: Paste shared Zoom recording links (cloud recordings on zoom.us or zoomgov.com, Zoom Events and Zoom Clips) and get a direct MP4 download link, the transcript as SRT, VTT, TXT or XML, and the recording's title, date, duration and size. No Zoom account, no browser extension.
useCases: Archive a course or webinar series before the share links expire
Turn recorded meetings into searchable transcripts and subtitles
Download public government meetings from zoomgov.com for records or reporting
Repurpose event recordings into clips and posts

faq.q: How do I extract the MP4 from a Zoom recording link?
faq.a: Paste the shared link (it contains /rec/play/, /rec/share/ or /clips/share/) and keep "Download videos" on. The result has a direct video_url to the MP4 file plus its size, so you can save it or send it to storage.

faq.q: Can I download a recording from zoomgov.com?
faq.a: Yes. Government tenants such as www.zoomgov.com and agency subdomains (usdot.zoomgov.com and similar) work the same way as zoom.us links.

faq.q: How do I get the transcript of a Zoom recording?
faq.a: Turn on "Download transcript" and pick SRT, VTT, TXT or XML. You get the transcript when the host enabled Zoom's audio transcript for that recording; has_transcript tells you if one exists.

faq.q: Does it work on passcode-protected or private recordings?
faq.a: No. It reads what the shared link shows to any visitor. A recording that asks for a passcode or a sign-in, or one that was deleted or expired, comes back with status failed and the reason.

faq.q: Do I need a browser extension or a Zoom account?
faq.a: No. It runs on Apify from the link alone, so you can process a whole list of links at once, schedule it, or call it from an API or Make, Zapier or n8n.

faq.q: Can it record or screen-scrape a live Zoom meeting?
faq.a: No. It works on recordings that were already saved to the Zoom cloud and shared as a link, not on live meetings.

officialApi: Zoom's Cloud Recording API lets an account's owner or admins list and download their own recordings, after creating an OAuth app and getting it approved. It cannot open a recording someone else shared with you. This actor works from the shared link alone, for any recording that opens without a passcode.
